import json, os, sys, time, tempfile, hashlib, platform, resource, subprocess, datetime, importlib.util
t0 = time.monotonic(); ROOT = '/home/ryan/rule30-lab'
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (1073741824, 1073741824))
sp = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('oracle', ROOT + '/scripts/check_three_return_signed_mass_independent.py')
oracle = importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp); sys.modules['oracle'] = oracle; sp.loader.exec_module(oracle)
for x in range(1, 2000): assert oracle.gen_t(x) == oracle.gen_t_bitwise(x)
def play(word):
    assert word[0] == 'u'; s = 1
    for ch in word[1:]:
        old = s; t = oracle.gen_t_bitwise(old)
        if ch == 't': s = t
        elif ch == 'u': s = t ^ 1
        else: s = t ^ 1 ^ (0 if old & 1 else 2)
    return s
w = 'uuuuputptutpuu'; x2 = play(w)
assert x2 == 0x642fdfb and len(w) == 14 and x2.bit_length() == 27
x1 = x2 >> 2; assert x1 == 0x190bf7e and x2 == 4*x1 + 3
s = oracle.forced_zero_schedule(x2)
assert s == 'tutututu' and s[1:7] == 'ututut' and oracle.admissible(s[:1] + 'utututu')
levels = oracle.build_frontiers('u', 13)
assert x1 in levels[13]
bd = oracle.belief_direct(levels, 13, x1, 1, [])
assert bd == oracle.belief_recursive(levels, 13, x1, 1, [])
MASKS = (0, 3, 11, 12, 15)
bins = {m: [0,0] for m in MASKS}
for y, c in bd.items():
    bins[sum(1 << d for d in oracle.fiber(levels, 12, y))][c % 2] += 1
vec = tuple(bins[m][0]-bins[m][1] for m in MASKS)
assert vec == (60, 0, 72, -9, 34) and sum(vec) == 157 and len(bd) == 357
cpu = next((l.split(':',1)[1].strip() for l in open('/proc/cpuinfo').read().splitlines() if l.startswith('model name')), 'unknown')
src = open(__file__).read()
summary = {'vector': list(vec), 'signed_mass': 157, 'belief_size': 357, 'even_odd_counts': {format(m, '04b'): bins[m] for m in MASKS}, 'witness_hex': hex(x2), 'schedule': s, 'strip_suffix': 3, 'mixed_sign': True}
rec = {'experiment_id': '20260905_orthant_mixed_vector_replay', 'timestamp_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'git_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(), 'question': 'problem1', 'hypothesis': 'The named orthant-test belief recomputes to the recorded mixed vector under the pre-existing independent oracle.', 'backend': 'python-exact-integers-direct-and-recursive', 'parameters': {'phase': 'u', 'node': ['0x190bf7e', 13, 1], 'witness': ['0x642fdfb', 14], 'max_frontier': 13, 'generator_cases': 1999, 'schedule_cap': 64, 'wall_limit_seconds': 120, 'address_space_bytes': 1073741824}, 'hardware': {'cpu_model': cpu, 'machine': platform.machine(), 'cpu_count': os.cpu_count(), 'peak_rss_kib': resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss}, 'software': {'python': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform()}, 'runtime_seconds': time.monotonic()-t0, 'result_hashes': {'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(src.encode()).hexdigest(), 'result_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest()}, 'source_text': src, 'result_summary': summary, 'interpretation': 'Mixed-sign vector corroborated: refutes the two-orthant restriction, not nonvanishing.', 'status': 'finite-exhaustive', 'proof_scope': 'One named belief by two implementations plus witness replay; no broader census.', 'limitations': ['No mass recomputation beyond dual agreement.', 'No all-depth claim.', 'Single case.']}
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir='/tmp', prefix='rec_', suffix='.tmp')
with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f: json.dump(rec, f, sort_keys=True, indent=2); f.write(chr(10)); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(tmp, '/tmp/orthant_sidecar_replay.json')
print('R1 orthant pass')
